audit.why: Even-to-favored early lane (52.53% WR, 712 games): Qiyana wins levels 1-6 on the packet chart, Aurora takes over at 2+ items via W kiting and R resets. Existing text captures this arc.
Spikes are right: level 3 full-element strings, level 6 wall stuns, first item lethality, Aurora out-scaling at 2+ items. spikes[] and phases[] agree with the packet chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fabricated ability names throughout the content layer: 'Bunny Hop' (Q is Twofold Hex), 'Twofold Movement / Spirit Abjuration (W)' (W is Across the Veil; Spirit Abjuration is her healing passive), and wants.foe[0] tells Aurora to save her passive to dodge an all-in. Full layer calls W '(Hop)' and cooldowns field has no numbers.
audit.why: Riot kit: P Spirit Abjuration (heal passive), Q Twofold Hex (9s rank 1, projectile), W Across the Veil (22s rank 1, leap + invisibility), E The Weirding (15s, slow + backhop), R Between Worlds (140s, slow zone + teleport across it).
audit.corrected: Real names and cooldowns written into spikes[0], whys[1], early, wants, breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aurora's Spirit Abjuration passive sustain never mentioned; anti-heal timing absent.

audit.corrected: Folded into dontsFull[2].d (full-bar rock damage gets healed back by passive spirits). Itemization report entry left alone to respect the two-report cap.
